messages.en: What are you up to?
Countryside Vacation is coming out soon!!
I'm so worried about how I look.
ChaeWon and I
already gave up.
We're just here to make everyone laugh.
Even if we are idols...
It had been a while since we did an event today,
so it felt kind of strange.
It felt like I had gone back to old memories.
It looks pretty atmospheric, doesn't it?
HaYeon, recommend me a song. It's been a while.
Right now,
I'm listening to "Dandelion."
What are you covering on the right?
YuBin unnie is hiding there. ㅋㄹㅌㄹㅋ
Our comeback is getting closer!!!
I had a schedule today too, but it was nice going out of Seoul for the first time in a while.
It was really healing.
But...
I miss you.
A lot.
It's raining too,
and it's so humid,
but when I think about Y/n,
even the rain starts to feel nice.
Yep, I'm flirting.
I need to turn myself in......
ㅋㄹㅌㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋ
You'll already be an adult in eight months.
Just saying.
Can't you just stay 19? ㅋㅋㄹㅋ
I said the same thing when you were 18.
Twenty-year-old HaYeon is going to be even more powerful.
Though by international age, I'm still 17.
ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.en: Once you're an adult you're going to get even prettier. What am I supposed to do? I'm already too excited to handle it.
I'll make sure you can't handle it.
I said this way back in the beginning.
I said I'd keep growing and become even better.

messages.ko: 초기때에 비해 많이 성장한거처럼 지금도 다시 말할게
messages.en: Just like I've grown so much compared to the beginning, I'll say it again now.
I'm going to grow so much it'll be scary!!!
Isn't that exciting?
It's like raising a character in a game.
HaYeon, who didn't know anything at first, has grown this much.
When does Country getaway come out~?
I can't wait to watch it.
After you watch it, leave your thoughts here.
Minute by minute, second by second.

messages.ko: 하연이는 어때 우리가 하연이 성장하는거 보고 좋아하는 반응 보면 재밌어?
messages.en: How about you? Is it fun seeing how happy we get watching you grow?
That's exactly what helps me keep growing.
I think, 'If I do this, they'll probably like it,'
'If I accomplish this, they'll be proud of me,'
With thoughts like that,
little by little,
I want to keep surprising you.
"When did she get this good??"
I want you to think things like that.
To me,
Y/n
I guess you're really precious to me.
Thank you always, my Hexagons~~ ❤️
The song I'm listening to right now is
"His Ocean" by Yerin Baek.
Somehow, the song reminds me of us.
Country getaway is coming out soon!
Just enjoy watching it, and don't pay attention to my face!
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Leave me your thoughts afterward.

messages.ko: 하여아 근데 민들레는 우효님거야 승관님거야 볼빨간사춘기님거야
messages.en: HaYeon, by the way, which 'Dandelion' were you listening to? OOHYO's, Seungkwan's, or Bolbbalgan4's?
OOHYO's!
Love you.
Sleep well in advance.
Bye~~
Haranghae. 🌼🩷
